rows.note: log2FC concordance of the sim vs a DESeq2 reference for a matched contrast. Read pearson_r AGAINST null_pearson_r (a high r is nearly free from the shared housekeeping backbone); a Deming slope far from 1 means the sim compresses/inflates the dynamic range. Each strong divergent gene is a model-limit hypothesis (attribute to a named parameter), unless it is a data artifact (short-gene zero, a total-mRNA-shift contrast needing spike-in normalization).
